summary: Grupo Simec, S.A.B. de C.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its audited results of operations for the twelve-month period ended December 31, 2025. The release compares year-over-year financial metrics, including a 10% decrease in net sales, a 12% reduction in cost of sales, and a 1% decline in EBITDA. No special-situation corporate event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is described. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. There are no deal terms, strategic changes, or activist activities to analyze.
